title: Hinomori Shiho — How Things Develop From Here〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Chocolate Factory

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
It's bigger than I expected!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This is where you and Kiritani made your chocolates for White Day...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I really didn't expect for us to come here together like this.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The Chocolate Factory...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ohhh! That's where Shiho went to make chocolates for White Day, right?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! Right now, they're doing a demo where you get to make chocolate crepes using batter with chocolate in it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We should totally go the next time we don't have practice♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But we got through that gauntlet of a practice schedule on top of putting on a great show, so I think we deserve a little reward.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
We should let Miku and the others know soon.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. They should be okay to come out since the staff's explaining things at that table over there.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Miku, Rin, Luka.
The coast is clear.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hiya♪ We're here...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Shhh!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Gwah...!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Rin, didn't you promise us that you'd be quiet?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Haha. Right...
Sorry, I'm just so excited...>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are the others not coming?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, they didn't want to be a bother by jumping on the bandwagon.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But they're really looking forward to us bringing back crepes for them.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That means we'll need to make them right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Rin, it looks like we have a lot of crepe batter options. How does fluffy and gooey sound?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Fluffy and gooey?
Yeah, that sounds fun♪>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Does fun work as a measure of taste?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. They seem to be happy with it, so why not?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, we can choose between mixing in chocolate sauce or chocolate powder.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm totes going with the Chocolate Factory's special chocolate sauce!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that case, I'll try using chocolate powder.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, it might be good to make some regular crepes as a way of adding some color to the mix.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I agree. After all, we eat first with our eyes.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, the batter's done. Shall we start making some?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Pour it onto the middle of the hot plate and spread it out as evenly as possible...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. Miku called the spreader a hammer too. A dragonfly may be more appropriate.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I didn't know it was used to spread the batter. No wonder it looks so strange...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, I'm gonna give it a go!
Pour the batter in the middle... And...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, huh? Where's my spreader?
It was right here a second ago!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Oh no! Sakki!
The batter's starting to cook! Hurry! You gotta find it and spread the batter!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, you two...
Here, you can borrow mine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're a lifesaver, Shiho...!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku, Luka, what should we do for toppings?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hmm... Some of those bite-sized cakes might be nice.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <As for me... Fruits, cream and... Oh, the Chocolate Factory's special chocolate sauce, please.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, aren't you putting on way too much...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? You think so? It's just bananas, strawberries and chocolate cake at this point.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I'm talking about how much of each you're trying to cram in.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<It's all good♪
The staff even said, “Just wrap it up and you'll be fine!”>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, Sakki, let's put some ice cream on top once it's wrapped!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! What kind of ice cream do you think KAITO would like?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's nice of you, but won't it melt before it gets to him?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Way ahead of you♪ They apparently have these freezers that help prevent it from melting!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, alright...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I'm making one for MEIKO next, so in terms of toppings...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-It's done...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Woohoo! Nice work, you guys♪>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Making our own crepes was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It was. Especially since we got to make the batter and choose our own toppings.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, and I still can't believe how well they all turned out.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I can't wait to have them with everyone.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Same. Let's head right over once the demo finishes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho! They said we can eat the leftover bananas and strawberries!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The staff even said we're welcome to have the chocolate sauce too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Whoa! That's so big-bellied of them♪>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Don't you mean “big-hearted”...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh yeah! But it's going in our tummies♪>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, that's not the point!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe.>
